_meta.description: Conventional efficiencies of heating and DHW systems per the 3CL-DPE 2021 method: emission (Re), distribution (Rd), regulation (Rr) and generation (Rg / SCOP / COP) plus the intermittence factor base I0. Heating consumption: Cch = Bch * INT / (Rg*Re*Rd*Rr); DHW: Cecs = Becs / (Rg*Rd*Rs) or Becs / (COP*Rd) for heat-pump water heaters.
_meta.source: Annexe 1 (méthode 3CL-DPE 2021) de l'arrêté du 31 mars 2021 modifié : Re §12.1 (p.75-76), Rd §12.2 (p.76), Rr §12.3 (p.76), Rg générateurs non-combustion §12.4.1 (p.76), SCOP PAC §12.4.2 (p.77), poêles/inserts §13.1 (p.78), formules Rpn/Rpint chaudières §13.2.2 (p.86-87), intermittence I0 et formule INT §8 (p.55), Rd ECS §11.5.1 (p.74), pertes ballons électriques §11.6.2 (p.75), Rs §11.6.3, COP chauffe-eau thermodynamiques §14.2 (p.95), réseau de chaleur ECS §14.3.
_meta.notes: V1 simplifications (documented in docs/deviations.md): (a) boiler seasonal generation efficiency approximated from Rpn/Rpint at the default nominal power below instead of the full load-profile weighting with Qp0 standby losses; (b) recovered losses (pertes récupérées) ignored in heating needs; (c) heating Rd uses the 'individual water network' rows. SCOP periods: pre-2008 values are COPs per the annexe footnote.

boiler_efficiency_formulas.note: Rpn/Rpint in % PCI as a function of log10(Pn[kW]). Seasonal Rg approximated in systems.py as a 0.3/0.7 weighted blend of full-load and intermediate-load efficiency (residential load profile is dominated by part load).

old_boiler_derating.note: V1: pre-1991 'classique' boilers use the standard formulas (identical per the annexe); higher standby losses Qp0 (4%/2%/1.5% of Pn by age) are approximated by an extra multiplicative derating.

intermittence.formula: INT = I0 / (1 + 0.1*(G - 1)) avec G = GV / (Hsp * Sh)

i0_house_individual.note: Maison individuelle, chauffage individuel, avec régulation pièce par pièce, équipement d'intermittence 'central sans minimum de température'; colonnes = inertie légère/moyenne vs lourde/très lourde.

electric_storage_losses.formula: Qg,w [Wh/an] = 8592 * (45/24) * Vs * Cr ; Rs = 1 / (1 + Qg,w*Rd/Becs) (1,08 au numérateur pour catégorie C/3*)

lighting.note: V1 uses the national average lighting hours (2123 h, §6.1 des apports internes) instead of the per-zone monthly Nh tables; documented deviation.
